versions.name: Camp Comer
versions.address: Comer Scout Reservation, near Mentone, AL

features.note: Pathfinder, the camp's first-year Scout program.
The C. M. Jesperson Dining Hall, with a screened porch used for meals and instruction.
Air conditioning in the Science and Technology Center leaders' lounge.
Flatt Rock Arena, used for opening and closing campfires.
A 50-foot tower with graduated walls and chimney climbs.
The Chuck Tate Waterfront on Lake Republic, with separate boating and swimming areas.
Lake Achunanchi, a smaller lake set aside for fishing.
A handicraft lodge with a woodworking shop, plus a handicraft shelter.
The Ecology Lodge, a rock building serving as the camp's nature center.
Two central shower houses with hot showers.
Two-bed canvas wall tents with canopy porches.

versions.summary: Sprawling 1,000-acre Scouts BSA resident summer camp set atop Lookout Mountain near Mentone, Alabama.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
